source: CPF Board published payout estimates (BRS/FRS/ERS, Standard Plan, male, payout start age 65). Update this file each year when CPF Board revises its payout tables — nothing in /src or /server should need to change.
notes: CPF LIFE payouts are not produced by a public formula. `payoutAnchors` are calibration points (male, Standard Plan, start age 65) that the app interpolates between for other balances, then adjusts for gender, plan, and deferral using the multipliers below.
Balances between anchors are interpolated on the payout-per-dollar ratio, not on the payout amount directly.
Figures are estimates only and will drift from CPF Board's actual tables over time — recalibrate `payoutAnchors` yearly against the latest BRS/FRS/ERS illustrations.

2026-08-30: FRS anchor and genderFactor.female recalibrated against user-supplied CPF-published figures for $220,400 RA, Standard Plan, start age 65 (Male $1,759/mo, Female $1,640/mo). The BRS and ERS anchors below are still the pre-recalibration estimates and have NOT been verified against current CPF-published figures — update them too if/when those numbers are confirmed.

escalatingPlan.description: Escalating Plan payouts increase by this rate each year after the first.

deferral.description: annualBonusRate approximates CPF's published ~42% cumulative payout increase for deferring from 65 to 70 (compounded). raInterestWhileDeferred is the ordinary RA interest rate applied to the deferred premium balance.
